drop procedure if exists dbo.GetSiteNavigation GO
create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetSiteNavigation] @ResourceID int = 0 as begin set nocount on; declare @NoReadAssetTypes dbo.ids;
insert into @NoReadAssetTypes (id) select * from [dbo].[AssetTypesUserCantRead](@ResourceID);
select Name as MenuID, SortOrder, 0 as Feature, Icon as Icon, ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, Title as Title, NULL AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav where Name = '#Monitor' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(ID, @ResourceID) = 1 union all
select Name as MenuID, SortOrder, 0 as Feature, Icon as Icon, ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, Title as Title, NULL AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav where Name = '#Home' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(ID, @ResourceID) = 1 union all
select n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](T.name) name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled, dbo.ArtifactSiteNavigation(T.ID, @NoReadAssetTypes) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = t.id WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectAssetTypeID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and not exists (select 1 from SiteNav v where v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = T.Object and v.Name = '#ASSET_TYPE') and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.[Class] = 1 Order By 1 FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#Business' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all
select n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](T.name) name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled, dbo.ArtifactSiteNavigation(T.ID, @NoReadAssetTypes) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = t.id WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectAssetTypeID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and not exists (select 1 from SiteNav v where v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = T.Object and v.Name = '#ASSET_TYPE') and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.[Class] = 8 Order By 1 FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#Technical' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, disabled, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](T.Name) Name, case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled, AUrl.Url As url FROM AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = t.id WHERE not exists (select 1 from SiteNav v where v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = T.Object and v.Name = '#ASSET_TYPE') and T.Object = 'TaxonomyType' ORDER BY 2 ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items, '' as [url] FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Models' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all
select n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, disabled, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](T.name) name, case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled, AUrl.Url As url FROM AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = t.id WHERE not exists (select 1 from SiteNav v where v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = T.Object and v.Name = '#ASSET_TYPE') and T.Object = 'PolicyType' ORDER BY 2 ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) as Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#Policy' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all
select n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, null AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#Reference' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 union all
select n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 4 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT 'People' AS name, 'community/groups' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS Items FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#Community' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 union all
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](T.name) name, AUrl.Url As url, 0 as feature, case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled, null AS items FROM AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = t.id WHERE T.Object = 'RuleType' and not exists (select 1 from SiteNav v where v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = T.Object and v.Name = '#ASSET_TYPE') Order By 1 FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items, '' as [url] FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Data Quality' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 union all
select n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT DISTINCT [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](R.name) name, CONCAT('dashboard/',R.Uid,'/preview') As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM Report R left join ReportResponsibility rs on rs.ReportID = R.ID left join ResponsibilityDetail rd on rd.ResponsibilityTypeID = rs.ResponsibilityTypeID and @ResourceID = rd.ResourceID WHERE (rs.ResponsibilityTypeID is not null and rd.ResourceID = @ResourceID) or (rd.ResourceID is null and rs.ResponsibilityTypeID is null) AND R.ReportType != 3 Order By 1 FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#Dashboards' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all select n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, null AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav n where n.Name = '#SemanticTypes' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all
select '~' + Name AS MenuID, s.SortOrder, 0 AS Feature, s.Icon as Icon, s.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, s.Title as Title, dbo.CustomSiteNavigation(ID, @NoReadAssetTypes) AS Items, '' as [url] from SiteNav s where ParentID IS NULL and Name not like '#%' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(s.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
union all
SELECT n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, case when ats.Icon is not null then ats.Icon else ( select case when at.Class = 1 or at.Class = 8 or at.Class = 7 then 'fa-book' when at.Class = 2 then 'fa-sitemap' when at.Class = 6 then 'fa-university' end as value) end as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, at.Name as Title, dbo.ArtifactSiteNavigation(at.ID, @NoReadAssetTypes) as items, 'assets/'+ cast(at.uid as nvarchar(36)) as [url] FROM SiteNav n left join AssetType at on at.Object = n.Object and at.ObjectID = n.ObjectID left join AssetTypeStyle ats on ats.id = at.ID WHERE n.Name = '#ASSET_TYPE' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 and not exists (select 1 from @NoReadAssetTypes nr where nr.id = at.ID)
order by sortorder end
